row.evidence: Attio's pricing comparison marks SCIM and Single sign-on only on Enterprise (Custom, billed annually), and the SCIM help article says "Available on enterprise plans."
row.notes: Unchanged status (gated). Prices rose since June: Plus is now $35/u/mo annual ($44 monthly, was $29) and Pro $79/u/mo annual ($99 monthly, was $69); Plus is capped at 10 seats. Enterprise is a custom quote; the June '~$119+/u/mo' figure had no first-party source and is dropped. SAML SSO and SCIM are both Enterprise-only; SCIM works without SSO but needs a verified domain to add users directly (otherwise invites). SCIM deprovisioning suspends the member, revokes sessions and frees the seat. REST API is on all plans but only reads workspace members; member writes go through SCIM. Okta OIN app provisions (SCIM only, no SAML in that app); Entra uses a non-gallery app pointed at the generic endpoint.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: The pricing comparison table shows SSO and SCIM check marks only in the Enterprise column (icons read from page markup).

auth.token_source: Workspace settings > Developers > + New access token (User Management: Read-write), or OAuth 2.0 via the Okta OIN app

deprovision.data_retained: Member is suspended (DELETE also suspends rather than removes). Company and people records they created stay; their synced emails and calendar events are deleted unless an admin chose to retain them when suspending manually.

attributes.notes: Entra guide lists four supported mappings (userName, active, name.givenName, name.familyName); role is sent as appRole (or the roles attribute per the help centre).

roles.how: appRole / roles attribute with values admin or member; unrecognised values default to member

rate_limits.text: General API limit 100 read and 25 write requests per second; no SCIM-specific limit documented.

limitations.text: If no seats are free, SCIM provisioning fails unless Automatic seat assignment is enabled.
Without a verified domain, SCIM can only send workspace invites.
With Okta, removing a user from a pushed group does not remove them from the Attio team.

rate_limits.text: 100 requests per second for reads, 25 per second for writes, across the whole API.

limitations.text: The non-SCIM REST API exposes only read endpoints for workspace members; create, suspend and role changes are documented only under the SCIM API (Enterprise).

okta.notes: OIN page marks SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push as checked; SAML is not checked for this app (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Attio's guide uses a non-gallery enterprise app pointed at the generic SCIM endpoint; no Entra gallery tutorial found (learn.microsoft.com attio-tutorial and attio-provisioning-tutorial return 404).
